LAYER4_MERGE.description: _compute_provenance() Layer 4 does not merge model config into current
LAYER4_MERGE.evidence: Line 239-246: Layer 4 iterates model_config but never calls _deep_merge(current, model_config). Layers 2+3 both merge. Asymmetric.
LAYER4_MERGE.severity: MEDIUM — current is not used after Layer 4, so no wrong results TODAY. But maintenance hazard if code extends.

PROVENANCE_OVERWRITE.description: _compute_provenance() overwrites provenance for all keys in a layer, not just changed values
PROVENANCE_OVERWRITE.evidence: No value comparison anywhere in _compute_provenance. Provenance says 'domain' even when domain re-states universal's value identically.
PROVENANCE_OVERWRITE.severity: MEDIUM — provenance is misleading but effective policy values are correct.

VALIDATE_UNIDIRECTIONAL.description: validate() checks registry→schema but not schema→registry direction
VALIDATE_UNIDIRECTIONAL.evidence: Only computes registry_hard_X - schema_hard_X. Never computes schema_hard_X - registry_hard_X.
VALIDATE_UNIDIRECTIONAL.severity: HIGH — HARD constraints in schema but not in registry will be silently unenforced.

NO_TYPE_VALIDATION.description: No runtime type/enum/min_layer validation of TOML values against schema
NO_TYPE_VALIDATION.evidence: validate() delegates to validate_all_policies() (monotonicity only) + coverage checks. Never inspects actual values. get_parameter() returns raw values without type checking.
NO_TYPE_VALIDATION.severity: HIGH — invalid TOML values silently accepted. Type = 'int' with value 'abc' passes.

LOAD_SCHEMA_NO_DEFAULT_CHECK.description: load_schema() never validates that default matches declared type or allowed_values
LOAD_SCHEMA_NO_DEFAULT_CHECK.evidence: load_schema() checks type/constraint_class/min_layer strings only. Never inspects default field.
LOAD_SCHEMA_NO_DEFAULT_CHECK.severity: MEDIUM — schema.toml currently consistent (all defaults match types). Would catch future errors.

DIFF_MISSING_TASK.evidence: Signature: diff_policies(self, domain_a, domain_b, model_a, model_b). No task_id.
DIFF_MISSING_TASK.severity: MEDIUM — cannot diff task-level policies. Interface incomplete.

DIFF_NO_DEFAULTS.description: diff_policies() compares raw TOML without schema defaults
DIFF_NO_DEFAULTS.evidence: Uses load_effective_policy() which doesn't inject defaults. Missing params show as <absent> not as default.
DIFF_NO_DEFAULTS.severity: LOW-MEDIUM — diff is misleading for params relying on defaults.

MIN_LAYER_NOT_ENFORCED.description: min_layer stored in schema but never enforced at runtime
MIN_LAYER_NOT_ENFORCED.evidence: min_layer loaded into ParameterDef but never compared against actual layer source.
MIN_LAYER_NOT_ENFORCED.severity: HIGH — parameter defined in wrong layer silently accepted.

VIOLATIONS_DEAD.evidence: violations only appears in dataclass definition. Never assigned in query() or anywhere else.
VIOLATIONS_DEAD.severity: LOW — dead field. Misleading API contract but no wrong behavior.

UNUSED_IMPORTS.description: Unused imports: Path, Sequence, tomllib, PolicyViolationError, _check_monotonicity
UNUSED_IMPORTS.verdict: CONFIRMED (5 unused: Path, Sequence, tomllib + 2 imported-but-unused-in-body)
UNUSED_IMPORTS.evidence: AST + text search confirms none used after import block.
UNUSED_IMPORTS.severity: LOW — cleanliness only. PolicyViolationError/_check_monotonicity may be intentional re-exports.

QUERY_DOUBLE_LOAD.description: query() and get_parameter() load TOML files twice (effective + provenance)
QUERY_DOUBLE_LOAD.evidence: Both call load_effective_policy AND _compute_provenance, each of which loads all TOML layers independently.
QUERY_DOUBLE_LOAD.severity: LOW — performance only at PoC scale. No correctness issue.

FLATTEN_SCHEMA_HEURISTIC.description: _flatten_schema uses fragile 'type' key heuristic to identify parameter definitions
FLATTEN_SCHEMA_HEURISTIC.evidence: Heuristic: isinstance(value, dict) and 'type' in value. Would misclassify a section named 'type'. Current schema.toml has no such collision.
FLATTEN_SCHEMA_HEURISTIC.severity: LOW — theoretical fragility. Current schema is safe.

SCHEMA_INCOMPLETE.description: schema.toml missing some active policy parameters (anti_deference sub-params)
SCHEMA_INCOMPLETE.evidence: anti_deference sub-params (agreement_requires_evidence, etc) ARE in schema.toml. But schema has 55 params vs potentially broader policy surface. Coverage adequate for current use.
SCHEMA_INCOMPLETE.severity: LOW — schema covers all registry HARD keys.

ENUM_TYPE_UNUSED.description: VALID_TYPES includes 'enum' but no schema param uses type='enum'
ENUM_TYPE_UNUSED.evidence: 3 params have allowed_values but type='string'. enum type exists in VALID_TYPES but is unused.
ENUM_TYPE_UNUSED.severity: LOW — dead type category. Misleading but harmless.

ERROR_HANDLING_ASYMMETRY.description: load_effective_policy raises FileNotFoundError for missing model; _compute_provenance silently skips
ERROR_HANDLING_ASYMMETRY.evidence: registry.py L271 raises. engine.py L242 silently skips with if exists() check.
ERROR_HANDLING_ASYMMETRY.severity: MEDIUM — query() would raise, but provenance would return partial result if model file missing.

SCHEMA_SEMANTIC_CONTRADICTION.description: sympy_auto_verify (bool) vs sympy_verification (string enum) semantic overlap
SCHEMA_SEMANTIC_CONTRADICTION.evidence: Both exist in schema. One is a bool toggle, other is mode selector. Overlapping semantics but not incorrect.
SCHEMA_SEMANTIC_CONTRADICTION.severity: LOW — design ambiguity, not a bug.

UNKNOWN_PARAMS_NOT_CAUGHT.description: Misspelled/unknown parameters in TOML files silently accepted
UNKNOWN_PARAMS_NOT_CAUGHT.evidence: No validation that TOML keys exist in schema. Typo 'anti_deferrence' accepted silently.
